googleReviews: I’ve been a customer for a couple years now. I really love the amount of beer options/flights, they’re rotated frequently. Though I think very few are actually made in house. The menu is more of a Vietnamese fusion cuisine meets bar food. My favorite dishes are the shrimp banh mi (you can tell the bread is fresh) and the noodle bowls. I’ve tried other menu items but nothing noteworthy. They often have events which can be a plus for some interested or a con for those wanting to dine in showing up on one of those days by coincidence. The service can be pretty hit or miss as well, but I’ve never had an overall bad experience. They have games to play as well but I’ve never wanted to deal with the hassle of breaking bills at a busy bar.

fantastic brewery with amazing food and a cool vibe.  I forgot to take a picture of the banh mi because I ate it too fast, but high quality.  fried dumplings were crispy and savory.  wake n shrimp rice bowl hit the spot.  I'm a stout head and they did not disappoint.  took 2 visits to try it all.  they have guest taps from Perennial and Prarie, 2 of my favorite breweries, but their own stouts managed to even top those.  I had never heard of this place before this weekend but they belong on a short list of the best breweries in the US.  if this place was near my home I would be here at least weekly.
Super cool bar with an arcade in the back which was a nice touch. Tasty selection of beers as well as delicious bar food with a Vietnamese twist.

First time visiting The Answer after several years and the beer was still great, the service was good but the food was not at all what I remember. I ordered the pork dumplings and they were really under seasoned and lacking flavor. I also got the pork belly banh mi and while the pork belly was crispy, the whole thing was really under seasoned and lacking salt. Maybe it was just an off day but I was disappointed.

We got the Banh Mi shrimp sandwich and the pork fried rice bowl.  Both were tasty but the sandwich was amazing, especially the bread.  We also got two flights and were impressed by the selection and variety of different and delicious beers on the menu.  My husband especially enjoyed the German Chocolate Cake beer and the Red and Blue Triple Puffsicle, both very flavorful and unique beers!
customer_insights: The Answer Brewpub offers a vibrant atmosphere with a unique Vietnamese fusion menu and a diverse selection of beers. While the food quality can vary, the overall experience is enjoyable, especially for groups looking for a lively night out.

googleReviews: I’ve heard about this place and had never been to the original location. I heard great things about this place so I was excited to check it out. We were seated promptly by the very friendly hostess in a snug little booth. The ambience was great, loud but not obnoxious. I’d say there were close to 30 tables taken, but I didn’t count.  Our server was wonderful, prompt and helpful. She checked in on us just enough times to make sure our waters were full and our food and drinks were delivered. The menu is robust and there are a lot of great options; it was hard to pick! I chose the shrimp scampi. When it was delivered, it was a soup. It was a lot of noodles, a lot of liquid, and what tasted like frozen shrimp. It was disappointing and I was just so surprised that this was what as served. The apple cobbler bread pudding made up for it. It was incredible! I would return but I would not recommend nor order the shrimp scampi.

Stopped in today for lunch and was really impressed. The service was fast, the food came out hot and fresh, and the atmosphere was comfortable and welcoming. The staff was polite and attentive without being overbearing. Overall, a great experience. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Highly recommend following Pat O'Brien RVA on Facebook for his schedule.

Dancing, laughing and singing were allowed.

googleReviews: This place is a dump.  Showed up at noon on a Sunday for a bite to eat and had to wait too long for service and it wasn't busy. My beer arrived and I'd already decided not to eat here as the general rule is if te bathroom is filthy, so is the kitchen. Oh, and the girl behind the bar added 20% gratuity for a party of one. I usually enjoy the food and service at Sky Box, which is why I recommended my friend join me for steak night. Unfortunately, this visit was beyond disappointing.

From the start, the short server with black/brown hair came off unwelcoming and downright rude. When we voiced our concerns to the manager, we were told she was the owner’s niece and that “that’s just how they operate.” Not exactly the customer service you expect when bringing someone for their first experience.

The menu doesn’t even bother asking how you’d like your steak cooked beyond “pink or no pink.” My friend requested well-done and I asked for pink — yet both steaks came out practically moo’ing. Raw, undercooked, and completely unappetizing. When we brought it up, we were met with more dismissive responses instead of any attempt to fix it.

At that point, we paid the bill, left the steaks and sides and walked out. Sadly, the nightmare didn’t end there — the next morning I had to take my friend to urgent care to treat food poisoning from that meal.

This was easily the worst dining experience I’ve had at Sky Box. Between the rude staff, the lack of care in preparing food safely, and the dismissive management, I cannot recommend steak night to anyone.

Great place, great value. Go online and see their menu. They provide food and great entertainment. Bingo,  poker,  karaoke,  all right,  nuff sed. Swing by.
Hey, Allen . Cheers. You are a good mixologist.  Thx 4 the BM's, Ciao . See ya Fri nite.  Karaoke. Byeeee
customer_insights: Dugout Bar and Grille is a casual dive bar known for its friendly atmosphere and delicious burgers. With a variety of entertainment options like karaoke and trivia, it's a great spot for both families and groups of friends looking for a fun night out.

address: 12 N 18th St, Richmond, VA 23223, USA
googleReviews: Had a great time with friends and good food! The fish and chips was so good and our entire table agreed the fries were perfect, just enough crispy/salt/potato ratio. Had a Guinness of course. The staff was laid back, you go to the bar to order and the bartender was a sweetheart. Foosball table in the back really put the cherry on top! The ambiance was nice, but I'm definitely going to go check it out on a busier night as it could've been more lovely.

Played many a show here and always had a blast packing out that room upstairs. The bar and food are wonderful. The owners are also great people. I think if you don't understand the ethos they are currently presenting, then maybe you never looked at or listened to the other folks around you in this fine establishment. Self reflection brings joy, as does McCormack's great staff and hospitality.

The staff is friendly and drinks are cold, what more could you ask for?
Food, yupp, they got delicious bites as well! Fish & Chips! Delicious burgers! Jalapeño poppers!

I recommend you stop by and see for yourself, maybe you'll make some new friends.

The atmosphere is comfortable and classy. The service is exceptional. The owner is a man of morals. I bought two shirts and will be back for a hoodie or two. Thank you Mac. You created something beautiful.

Always had the most enjoyable time here. Metal Mondays weren’t exactly to my liking musically but giving bands more opportunities to be seen/heard is A+ by me. Try to get here each and every time I am in Richmond. Hope more people check out a real punk bar.
customer_insights: McCormack's Irish Pub is a lively and casual venue known for its friendly atmosphere and delicious pub fare, including highly praised fish and chips. The pub features a foosball table and hosts live music events, making it a great spot for both social gatherings and a fun night out.

address: 321 W 7th St, Richmond, VA 23224, USA
googleReviews:
We arrived as a large group of about 10 couples at noon on Friday. Restaurant was clean and inviting. No signs though to direct you to self seating on ordering.
We all ordered and meals came out slowly. Those that received meals first were done well before the half of the others had received their meals. So about 8 out 20 were done before the remaining 12 got served.
Wings were good. Hot chicken breast sandwich was small and $15. Brussel sprouts appetizer was really good and shareable.
Nice bar and brews.

Good beer, but needs cleaning. Open kitchen looks like a pots and pans dish washing staging area. Food sounded good on menu, but seeing the condition of the place changed our minds. Oh, and $2.50 for a few oz cup of cheese for the $6 pretzel is outrageous.

Been coming here for a while. The beer is superb, the staff is professional and hospitable. The food is impeccable. Any day of the week is a good day to go to Legends. Definitely a staple of the city of Richmond

Found out this place does $1 wing nights on Wednesday’s and we’ve been coming every week since! What a deal!!! The wings and their drink, ‘the richmonder’ are delicious! Service has been great every single time we’ve come and the views of the city from the outdoor patio are stunning 😍

Great Brewery!  Wonderful outdoor patio that kind of overlooks The James.  Also, one of the few places that you can also get some taste of some Deutch food.  Live music, trivia, and movie night.  Plus, all their own and other beer selections.  Service is very good and so is the food.  Getting to it, you might think it's in a skecty area, but not the case. Well worth your time to check it out!
customer_insights: Legend Brewing Co is a popular brewery in Richmond known for its vibrant atmosphere and stunning outdoor patio views. While the food and service can be hit or miss, the brewery offers great deals like $1 wing nights and hosts various events, making it a lively spot for groups and casual gatherings.

address: 12830 W Creek Pkwy Unit J, Richmond, VA 23238, USA
googleReviews: An amazing place that is so personable and friendly!  If you are in the west side of Richmond, this brewery is absolutely worth a stop. The beers were great! They were having a big concert event, so they typically don't do flights, but when we explained we were from Texas, they were gracious enough to pour us some. Loved their Mexican Lager and their flagship IPA, Headspace. Definitely check them out!

Everyone who works for this establishment must truly love what they do.  The team is knowledgeable,  friendly, and go beyond expectations to provide a great experience.   And the beer is outstanding as well.

Don't know what I expected being located In a business park, but it exceeded all expectations. Service was fast and friendly with great recommendations, the the atmosphere was cozy and welcoming. Love that they take a lighthearted approach to their beer. Oh, and I found their beer to be quite good with enough assortment for most people. COVID safety, they put a sign on the table stating it has been cleaned, great idea! They have two good size decks if you are interested in sitting outside. Fun place, make sure and check it out.
Update: they changed policy where dogs are now allowed inside the building not just outside on the deck!
Great venue space and awesome live music. Loved the Mexican chocolate stout!
Great atmosphere and food! Ordered the chicken, it was life changing. The live music was nice too. The employees were so sweet, will definitely be back soon!
customer_insights: Kindred Spirit Brewing is a friendly and welcoming brewery located in a business park in Richmond. Patrons rave about the knowledgeable staff, great beer selection, and cozy atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for casual gatherings and live music events.

address: 434 Hull Street Rd, Richmond, VA 23224, USA
googleReviews: Fabulous taproom. Nice workers and cool atmosphere, makes for a really cool hangout stop. If I lived near it I would be a regular. Also, the beer is fantastic.

Beautiful taproom, clean and modern. Most importantly the brews are excellent. Kevin is in full control behind the bar, knows his beer A-Z and has a great knowledge of the area as well.

"Treat yo' self" and eat one of the best dang hot dogs you'll likely ever find. I can't remember the last one I had because I'm not really a fan, the one I ate here was fantastic!

Oh sorry this is all that is left of the amazing fire stone cooked Pizza I enjoyed tonight! Perfect place to wind down, caught some poetry and the beer selection is the best on this side of town!!! Will be back again next Wednesday! I hope we have more Pizza like this in the future !

Me and my family came here recently for a bingo night and it was so much fun ! We enjoyed playing, jamming out to some Beyoncé 😜, and the food was delicious we got the dirty hot dog with chilli & shredded cheese, and nachos. I definitely recommend this fun activity for everyone you will love it! Thank you Benchtop Brewing & Mrs. Maggie! 🦄⚡️💚🤩👏🏾
Great beer, and good food. Nice small tap room. Make sure you look for all of the small roosters around. I saw about 20 while I was there.
customer_insights: Benchtop Brewing is a vibrant taproom known for its fantastic beer selection and a fun, casual atmosphere. The venue hosts engaging events like bingo nights and live music, making it a great spot for social gatherings with friends or family.

address: 3110 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews:
We quickly popped in here 10 minutes before closing to pick up a growler of beer, and we were so pleasantly surprised having never been here before. The bartender was nice and helpful, and he gave us great options.

Their pumpkin seasonal is a really good dark (but not heavy) ale, full of pumpkin flavor.  They had a Granny Cider that wasn't overly sweet. And, an Triple IPA that didn't smack you in the face with IPA (but also super strong). Be sure to get your best sipping glass for it!

If you're a fan of more sweet hard ciders and/or sour ales, stop into Strangeways Brewing. They sell all kinds of beer and the menu is organized by flavor. I ordered a flight of all the tart beers and found them unique. The Lucky Charms one is unique and tastes like the cereal. The cider is excellent and I loved the Razzle sour ale. So refreshing!

The space is one big room with plenty of tables and a corner of games. Most of the games are broken and come with missing pieces.

The service was efficient and friendly enough. Staff didn't seem thrilled to have three kids at the brewery, but alas.

I'm new to Richmond and stopped by while walking my dogs. Plenty of shaded seating on the side outdoors and the friendliest of people...I had someone offer to carry out a bowl of water for my dogs while I had 2 leashes and a beer in tow. Inside was cool and caters to military, teachers, locals--you name it. If the light beer I got (I'm on Keto for 60 days so a light beer already blows half my daily carbs) is any indication, I'm excited to return Memorial Day off my diet to explore all the sours, IPAs, and darker things I enjoy. I had the best light beer here I've ever had, though I rarely order light. 5 stars for sure!

Enjoyable brewery! Staff were friendly and attentive, and it gave off similar vibes to the OG production facility location a short drive away. Beer is enjoyable with plenty of sizes and options to choose from. The blues band playing elevated the experience. Great place to hit when trying to knock out all the Scott’s Addition breweries.

I visited around 1:30 during an "adult book fair" that ran from 12-4. The book fair was FANTASTIC, featuring local authors and other books my wife loved. It didn't pack the taproom, and there was plenty of seating.
The rest of the experience, however, was unfortunately poor. I waited in a 15+ minute line for beer while a single bartender struggled to provide good interaction and serve beer and food to each person. He disappeared multiple times to prep food and deliver it, but clearly had no other choice. Another bartender appeared halfway through the wait, but spent his time catching up on dishes and doing... something? else, despite the massive line.
The beer was fine, but I wasn't about to wait in that line for another, so this was a one-and-done. MANAGEMENT, if you're gonna schedule an event, be sure to schedule staff to go with it. Your people tried their best, but you set them up for failure.
customer_insights: Strangeways Brewing RVA-Scott's Addition is a casual brewery known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse beer selection, including unique sours and ciders. The venue is pet-friendly and features outdoor seating, making it a great spot for groups or casual hangouts, though service can be inconsistent during busy events.

venueName: Basic City Beer Co. Southside RVA
address: 212 W 6th St, Richmond, VA 23224, USA
googleReviews: Really cool joint. Great atmosphere, seems like it was an old industrial building back in the day. Beautiful exposed brick and machinery from back in this buildings hay day. Beer was wonderful, American IPA that is not overly hopped but still has some good bitterness to it. Parking seems like it might be tough if it gets busy but was perfectly fine when was there.
Great beer, easy access. Why sitting at home when you could be here?!

My favorite brewery in Richmond, hands down.
Curtis and Sara are incredible owners who create a welcoming atmosphere — the kind of place where you walk in and instantly feel like you're among friends.

They offer an impressive variety of beers: IPAs, DIPAs, sessions, lagers, and imperials. My go-to is the 6th Lord — a perfect daily drinker.

The space is huge, making it ideal for group hangouts or just a chill night with a couple of friends. It’s also kid-, dog-, and bike-friendly, with a game room tucked in the back to keep everyone entertained.

And if you're hungry? Their pizzas are legit.

Highly recommend. See you there!

Been a year of coming in. People are always good. Beer is always fresh. Things are straightforward and you can meet friends just by being you. The speciality beers that rotate are better than you’d imagine. I’d say go towards medium to fuller body brews and keep your dog ready for treats.

I really enjoy the food and FOH staff, and probably everyone and everything there minus the head pizza guy. This review is solely because of him because I go here every so often for events, trivia, and just to hang out with friends. I dont understand his problem with me but he continues to go out of his way to be a completely and utterly rude, aggressive, drunk old man. If I try to bus my own pizza tray, he rips it out of my hands. Ive helped a dnd event where he kept asking me why I was there and how we didnt need 3 people to host the event...? Im sorry im contributing to the establishment by buying pizza. I feel very uncomfortable when he is around, he is always staring so aggressively. Drinks on the job constantly so maybe thats why? Very miserable old man  whatever the case. I really hate going to Basic City because of this specific individual so no more!
customer_insights: Basic City Beer Co. Southside RVA is a casual brewery with a welcoming atmosphere, perfect for group hangouts and dog-friendly outings. While the beer selection is highly praised, the venue has occasional service issues, particularly with one staff member, which may affect the overall experience.

address: 4300 Williamsburg Ave, Richmond, VA 23231, USA
googleReviews: Very cool location, and a beautiful building. The beer is fantastic and the staff were wonderful and very helpful with the selection of beers.

Been here a few times for various occasions and it’s a great spot! Great selection of beverage options, especially for people who may not drink beer but are out with people who do. Stone also hosts little vendor fairs and such, which are nice to check out. Thank you to all of the amazing staff who keep this beautiful brewery clean and hospitable all the time! Your hard work and care for your craft truly shows.

Stone was very kind and accommodating when my boat party got canceled due to rain! We were able to quickly pivot and squeeze in. We made the mistake of bringing outside food but they didn’t make us feel bad about it. I’m excited to come back to trivia and I’m glad I got to introduce 13 new folks to this spot.

Customer service is great. Accommodating, helpful and explain things in detail. Clean inside and out. I appreciate that they offer wireless internet since it seems to be located in a dead zone and service can be spotty regardless of service provider. Plenty of parking options. It's a walk to the parking lot and some areas are not lit enough. It's a 4 out of 5 for me.

What I love about this space is you are so close to the city but feel so far. It's proximity to an undeveloped wooded area, a train track, and the river feel like a reprieve from the busyness of life (though the train can be loud.)  They've got a great selection, indoor and outdoor seating, and a food truck.
customer_insights: Stone Brewing Tap Room in Richmond is a vibrant and welcoming venue known for its fantastic beer selection and accommodating staff. The brewery offers a unique atmosphere that feels both close to the city and a retreat from its busyness, making it suitable for various social occasions, including trivia nights and casual gatherings.

address: 1603 Ownby Ln, Richmond, VA 23220, USA
googleReviews:
Cool location that offers live music. Plenty of space with an older building that provides character.

Beer was average but I am super picky about beer having been traveling the craft beer scene for two decades.
Thumb Stick event at Main Line Brewery. Great beer as always.  A little drive out of the way but well worth it.

I watched the people standing on the corner of Leigh and Hermitage directing the Give a Dog a job thing throw a broken Hennessy bottle into the bushes and left it. Why is iit ok for y'all to put the pets of the people that live here at risk while your people interrupted an entire community due to posting no notifications.

Great location with plenty of outdoor and indoor space to enjoy. There is a great selection of beer and a separate section that mixes some great vodka drinks. Live music is popular here and there is always a good crowd of people. Dog friendly and a good choice for a weekend outing or happy hour.

Love this space, we have our jeep events here with River City Wranglerz and it is a great time every time. Always has live music on Sundays.
Good drinks, good prices and good people. They have a rum bar, vodka area and beer area. There is also an inside and outside stage for events and bands and LOTS of space to enjoy. Dog friendly!!
customer_insights: Main Line Brewery is a vibrant venue known for its live music and spacious layout, making it a great spot for social gatherings. While the beer selection received mixed reviews, the atmosphere is lively and dog-friendly, appealing to a diverse crowd looking for a casual night out.

address: 147 Monroe Church Rd, Rice, VA 23966, USA
googleReviews: From the amazing staff, to the delicious cocktails (get the Notorious F.I.G!!) and tasty pizza ... this place has it all!  Awesome setting & scenery too - 5 ⭐ experience

My wife and I stopped here on a whim while traveling home from a weekend trip. This place is simply amazing! The location is very peaceful and calming. Had a tasting of all the bourbons and was very surprised at how good they were for being aged 2-4 years. The smoked old fashioned was incredible as well. Don’t skip out on the pizza as it’s out of this world. We will definitely come back and bring the kids next time as there is so much to do. Great experience!

My husband, son and I all came to celebrate a late Father’s Day due to booking constraints (so book in advance). What an amazing family experience from the outdoor course to the distillery afterwards. Take the time to invest in familial experience and a great drink and laugh afterwards with Shannon and the crew. Had a favorite dirty martini made by Miss Shannon in the distillery and it was aesthetically pleasing and yummy to boot! Thank you to the staff that were friendly, patient and well educated in their fields from the outdoor course to making a beautifully delicious drink! Yall rock!

Lot's of fun for children here. The crabs were amazing! They bring them out in buckets and you eat them at the table covered with brown paper. The distillery has glass windows so you can see the equipment they use to make various libations.

My experience here was wonderful and given the atmosphere of this place it was a place you can expect to just forget about the world around you as you sit on the tables they have in the patio. Staff is nice and understanding and they can make you feel that your heard and safe as you enjoy burning time with the options they have to offer. Its just one of those places you can escape from things and simply breath in everything. Time is your friend here especially when you bring a crowd or some friends memories will be burned into your mind as you enjoy doing nothing but eating food, sipping drinks, and being away from the every day life.
customer_insights: Sandy River Distillery offers a relaxed and family-friendly atmosphere with a focus on bourbon tastings and delicious pizza. Guests appreciate the scenic outdoor setting and friendly staff, making it a great spot for casual gatherings and special occasions.

address: 2910 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: We love this place, but I have to say our visits went from like 6 times in one year to only 1 time since they stopped contracting with KoBop. I have no idea who initiated the end of that relationship, however it made Busky Cider my favorite go-to place with friends. We introduced several people to Busky who also loved the Busky-KoBop combo but haven’t gone back since it ended. Regardless, it’s a nice cidery with yummy flavors, fun flights, games available and alcoholic ice cream. It’s just not the same without the amazing food! If you ever have the chance to work with KoBop again, please know you’d have a LOT of eager people returning!

Went to Buskey Cider with my friend and we loved it!! The best cidery in Richmond. Our favorite cider was Watermelon Rosemary. DELICIOUS. Definitely check this place out. The staff was nice, high energy, and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!!

Stopped by here on my birthday over the weekend and it was wonderful!! The staff was amazing and knowledgeable. The cider was delicious and there were so many great options to choose from! They even let me pick out a free cozy since it was my birthday. I will definitely be making another trip back! :)
Absolutely delicious cider! They have a great variety to try and none of them are bad. If you're a cider fan in Richmond- this is the place to go.
Really great ciders. Wonderful flavor profiles. Friendly Staff and a very cool space.
customer_insights: Buskey Cider is a popular cidery in Richmond known for its delicious and diverse cider offerings. While some patrons miss the food partnership with KoBop, the vibrant atmosphere, friendly staff, and unique options like alcoholic ice cream make it a great spot for casual gatherings and celebrations.
